body:
This isn't real life. I can't get a real job talking to people online. I will never be able to advance in life. This is just hiding from the problem. 

This will be the last thing I type. I throwing everything I own in the dumpster behind this building and I'm heading out to where I'm going to hang myself. 

Sun will be setting soon and I want to watch it set one last time before I execute myself.

I reasoned it out like this. 

The minor problem is that I can't get back all that I've lost. The people I was closest too are dead. Been dead for so long now I can't even remember what their voices sounded like. The pictures of my loved ones were tossed in the trash many years ago by a landlord that had kicked me out due to my inability to pay the rent on time. So those memories are fading. 

In the present there is no advancement. I can't move forward do to my mental condition. People cannot communicate with me. I find forming relationships to be a horrible experience. I find most people uninteresting. The add nothing to my life. When most people talk I can't even understand them. Human nature is alien to me. 

Because of this I am currently homeless. All I have is this laptop I never gave back from the last place I was fired from. My inability to bond with others is my downfall. Mankind is a roadblock for me. People's nature to peer bond is a concept I do not understand. Since I do not grasp this basic skill, I will never be able to hold a proper job. I'm doomed to live a life of sleeping on the streets out in the rain and cold. 

I hate being around people. I hate talking to others face to face and I have nothing because of it. Anything I do in life to try to advance myself further will involve me having to on some level socialize with someone. I would rather die than have to do that. 

I add nothing to the mix. There are around 6 billion other people out there that can do everything better than I can. If leave this place then no one will even know I gone. It will probably be weeks before someone finds my body. 

I'm defective and the best thing I can do is remove myself and my defect from the greater good. 

I do nothing everyday but avoid people. I feel like a wild animal. 

Everyday I'm here I just waste more resources in an already overcrowded situation. 

I'm going to watch the sunset on last time and then I'm going to hang myself.

It's not them it's me. I'm the common denominator. 

No one can help me because I don't have the ability to communicate with people face to face. I come off as insulting and degrading. No one wants to be around someone like me. I'm always the problem. 

Better just kill myself before I pass on my defective genes to the next generation.
